description: INRAE and Thai researchers monitored domestic refrigerators in 123 Bangkok households. The Data in Brief article and Recherche Data Gouv metadata describe five-minute temperature and relative-humidity measurements at several internal positions, including shelves, vegetable drawers and freezer compartments. A meat-like test product and the ambient air near each appliance were also instrumented. The named repository page and API opened at version 2.0. The API lists 373 files, including tab-delimited measurement text, preview plots and a README, with no file marked restricted. Repository terms state CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the DataCite rights list is empty. Coverage is a recruited sample of homes in one tropical city, not a census of refrigerators or a complete annual performance record. Appliance type, door opening, loading and household behaviour can change internal conditions; raw sensor gaps and calibration were not checked. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating food cold-chain temperature exposure or household refrigeration-energy simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk and data-jarw-japan-cold-storage-statistics are related household-energy and cold-storage resources, but no measurements were mapped between them. No text measurements, plots or article PDF were downloaded.
